summary: Greenland Mines Ltd (formerly Klotho Neurosciences, Inc., formerly ANEW Medical, Inc., formerly Redwoods Acquisition Corp.) filed an 8-K reporting entry into a securities purchase agreement for a registered public offering. On August 26, 2026, the company agreed to sell 1,632,783 common shares and pre-funded warrants exercisable for up to 2,367,517 shares at $5.00 per share ($4.9999 per pre-funded warrant), with expected net proceeds of approximately $18.5 million. The offering closed around August 27, 2026 under an effective S-3 registration statement. Proceeds will fund the acquisition of the Sarfatoq project and working capital. Pre-funded warrants have a $0.0001 exercise price and a 4.99% (or 9.99% at holder election) beneficial ownership limitation. The transaction is a capital raise; watch for dilution and use of proceeds.
